objects.name: base
objects.prompt:
A large cute ancient forest guardian boss for a fantasy pixel-art RPG, a massive squat living tree creature called Thornroot Warden. 64x64 pixel art character sprite, low top-down isometric-friendly view.
Thick ancient stump-like body, oversized twisted branch arms, several large roots forming short sturdy legs, moss and small green leaves growing naturally across the bark, one small broken branch on the crown, and a glowing emerald nature core embedded in the center of its trunk.
The creature should feel ancient, heavy and powerful while still charming and readable in the cute Bunny World monster style. Large broad silhouette, approximately 2–2.5 times the visual mass of a normal monster. Short and wide rather than tall and humanoid.
Dark warm brown bark, muted forest greens, small bright emerald accents from the nature core. Strong clean pixel clusters, limited palette, crisp intentional pixels, readable facial expression and silhouette at gameplay scale.
Same visual language and pixel density as cute compact fantasy RPG monsters, but genuinely larger and more detailed because this is a MAP BOSS.
No weapon, no armor, no scenery, no ground, no shadow, no particles, no UI, transparent background.
IMPORTANT: Do not make it look like a generic tall humanoid Ent. It must be a squat, chunky, root-legged ancient tree beast with an oversized boss silhouette.

objects.name: base
objects.prompt: ORIGINAL Mushroom Brute elite enemy for Bunny World, a larger and heavier relative of the supplied Sporekin reference. Oversized broad mushroom cap, chunky compact woodland body, short powerful arms and legs, visibly heavier elite silhouette while retaining the exact same restrained tiny pixel-art family. Cute but sturdy and hostile, simple readable face, sparse crisp pixel clusters, no armor, no weapon, no clutter, no excessive spots or detail. Side-facing right, walk-ready contact pose, stable feet. Use the supplied ACTUAL Goblin and Skeleton pixels for pixel density and gameplay readability and the supplied Sporekin for family identity. Fill more of the 32x32 canvas than the normal monsters. Transparent; no ground, shadow, scenery, text, glow, antialiasing, vector, painting or 3D.
